name: ElevenLabs
title: ElevenLabs: ElevenAgents API server-side request timeouts (behavior change)
summary: Starting November 26, 2026, the ElevenAgents API (/v1/convai) enforces server-side request timeouts. During temporary increases in latency, a request may return HTTP 504
replacement: Handle 504 responses in your client, for example by retrying with backoff.
